statement: Let d>n, with partitions ν,λ¹,…,λᵏ totaling n(d−n). Prescribe ν at infinity and λʲ at distinct conjugation-invariant osculation points, with the first 2c points conjugately paired and λ^(2i−1)=λ^(2i). The real solution count with multiplicity is at least the absolute coefficient of ∏_i x_i^(d−i−ν_(n+1−i)) in Δ_n(x)∏_(i=1)^c s_(λ^(2i))(x₁²,…,x_n²)∏_(j=2c+1)^k s_(λʲ)(x), where Δ_n=∏_(i<j)(x_i−x_j) and s denotes a Schur polynomial.
